column3: With respect to the Columbus Park Crossing Mortgage Loan (7.8%), Chili’s, an outparcel tenant, has a Right of First Refusal to purchase its leased parcel if the borrower receives offer as to such Chili’s parcel separately that it is otherwise willing to accept: The ROFR is not extinguished by foreclosure; however, the ROFR does not apply to foreclosure or deed in lieu thereof.
